cautions.en: No public pricing; deployment (cloud vs on-premise), licensing model and implementation scope are negotiated per customer, so total cost of ownership varies widely and typically includes large implementation/consulting fees.

capabilities.en: Next-generation enterprise ERP suite covering finance, supply chain, manufacturing and procurement with an in-memory (HANA) database for real-time analytics.
Embedded AI features for process automation and decision support across ERP modules.
Available in cloud (public/private) and on-premise deployment options.

limitations.en: No self-serve pricing or sign-up; requires a sales engagement and implementation project before go-live.
Designed for large organizations replacing legacy ERP systems, not for solo freelancers or very small teams.

reason.en: Cloud ERP competitor targeting mid-market to large organizations.
Direct enterprise ERP/finance competitor from Microsoft.
Major cloud ERP suite competing for the same large-enterprise segment.

unknowns: No indicative pricing figures exist publicly; cost depends entirely on a custom quote and implementation scope.
